person.headline: People and Culture Partner | @Peach Pubs
person.about_me:
From Artworker to Bar worker - The true life story of a Hospitality Addict.

My Insights Discovery Profile tells me that I am Creative which would explain my university degree in Design and my first job on the career ladder as an Artworker for an amazing family ran print and embroidery company.  Was the pay fantastic at an entry level position....absolutely not.. was I a 20 year old with a weakness for fine food and a lavish glass of vino ...most definitely 

Enter the beer token job - The part time bar tender - A story that is reflected in hundreds and thousands of Caterers CV's worldwide and one which I myself am extremely proud to be a part of.  

I love everything about hospitality and I truly believe that you will never find a more passionate, enthusiastic, inspiring and honest group of people than those who work in the Industry.  

18 years down the line and I can say hand on heart that sliding my CV over the bar in my local Beefeater was the best career decision I ever made.  As I sit here now on the receiving end of the CV exchange process I am eternally grateful that on that day 18 years ago someone saw something in me that wasn't just about experience but about talent and potential. 

Present day - Chief Talent Finder for Peach Pubs - The Best Gastro Pub Company on the Planet. 

At Peach we have a simple saying and that is to make life peachy - and here I am striving to make life peachy for team members past, present and future.  At peach we really do believe that people are the key to our success and that true talent can come from anywhere - we encourage individuality and as long as you are in it with us the sky is the limit.

I hope you enjoyed my little intro and please do reach out if you are thinking about making life peachy with a career in Peach.

Incidentally my other character trait on the Discovery wheel is Accommodating - but I'm sure you guested that already ... stay peachy everyone and lets connect
